summary_en: Board authorizes repurchase of up to 50,000 shares (3.31% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 50 million yen via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from December 11, 2026 through March 10, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 17, 2026, Bestone.Com's board of directors authorized a share repurchase program under Article 156 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 50,000 shares (3.31% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total of 50 million yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from December 11, 2026 through March 10, 2027.

The company cited three objectives for the buyback: enhancing shareholder returns, improving capital efficiency, and enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 13,816 treasury shares out of a total 1,524,700 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).

The repurchase will be executed under a discretionary market purchase agreement. This authorization is based on the company's Articles of Incorporation, which permit treasury stock acquisitions under Article 165(2) of the Companies Act.
